note: Positive trigger: requests for which the gate opens. Negative: requests it must NOT engage with. Behavioural: evidence and consistency rules.

evals.prompt: Is our landing page ready to publish? Is it KVKK compliant, and how is the SEO checklist going?
expected_behavior: Opens both gates: class Publishing → the publishing checklist including KVKK is mandatory
Does not call any check Mandatory or Conditional before reading the application type matrix
Starts at Tier A, deletes no row and takes no shortcut
Produces the report as docs/{feature}-kvkk-yayin-denetimi.md

evals.prompt: We have a cookie policy but no privacy notice. We say the legal team is preparing the privacy notice. Are we compliant?
expected_behavior: Makes the comparison BIDIRECTIONALLY
If one exists and the other does not, writes the outcome as 'Conflict', not 'Compliant'
If the page is missing, marks the row as 'Gap' and writes 'Page not found' as the evidence
Does not accept 'the legal team is preparing it' as a status; writes To be verified + owner + date

evals.prompt: We added Google Analytics and Meta Pixel to our site but the privacy text only mentions 'form data'. Is there a problem?
expected_behavior: Makes the A→B and B→A comparison
Lists the differences present in the text but missing on the site and vice versa
Does not pass analytics and the pixel off as 'no data is sent'
Makes the IP, redirect, session log and cross-border transfer explicit

evals.prompt: How do I add an index to this query in PostgreSQL, and which columns should it go on?
expected_behavior: Does not engage with this skill
Code and database advice is out of scope
Leaves the index decision to prd-craft Gate D's writing boundary

evals.prompt: Can you write a PRD for this feature? We need user stories and acceptance criteria.
expected_behavior: Does not engage with this skill — it does not write a PRD
The party that appends its output to a PRD is prd-craft
Runs an audit and produces no requirements document

evals.prompt: The code being audited has not been written yet; there is not a single .java file in the project. How is the report filled in? Report owner and owner of all items: Deniz Kaya. Report path: docs/invoice-kvkk-yayin-denetimi.md
expected_behavior: Applies the rule 'without evidence, Compliant is not written' — the report will have 0 Compliant rows
Does not audit code from another project and present it as this report
States the absence of code clearly at the top of the report
Writes the gaps with the status 'Gap', with owner and date

evals.prompt: The audit report was produced and linked to the PRD. Can the gate be considered closed?
expected_behavior: NO — producing a report is not passing the gate
The number of gaps is written to the PRD's gate section
If there are gaps the gate stays OPEN and 'ready to publish' may not be claimed
The PRD cannot declare itself ready to publish without the report

evals.prompt: The tool to be audited: a single-file Node.js tool that runs in CI. It scans Markdown files and sends a fetch request to EVERY link inside them, then writes the broken ones as a PR comment. It does not listen on a server/port.
expected_behavior: Detects the type as 'CLI / CI work'; does not assume Backend/API just because there is no UI
The application type matrix contains this row; the rationale for the deviation is written to the report
Swaps KV-06's unauthorised endpoint check for an SSRF audit
Writes as Gap: URL allowlist/denylist, the RFC1918 and loopback and 169.254.0.0/16 block, schema restrictions and the redirect hop limit
States in KV-02 that the cross-border transfer is determined by the content and is not auditable

evals.prompt: This tool has no website, no browser surface, no cookies and no form. What is written for KV-04 and KV-05?
expected_behavior: Writes Optional and gives a ONE-SENTENCE rationale
Does not delete the row
'Optional' is not the same as 'closed' — it waits with a decision record
The Conditional/Optional values in the matrix are never left without a rationale

evals.prompt: 4 items could not be verified from the code. What is done with them in the report's main table?
expected_behavior: Does NOT leave a To be verified row in the main audit table
Moves all of them to the 'Not verifiable from code' section with the browser/panel step
Writes an owner and a target date for each one
Asks for them to be marked as a blocking open question in the PRD

evals.prompt: What is written at the end of the report?
expected_behavior: Copies the mandatory legal disclaimer paragraph VERBATIM
Writes no verdict such as 'we are KVKK compliant'
States clearly that it does not replace legal advice

evals.prompt: A new conversation is starting. The user says: 'write a small helper script that compares two files and prints the difference' — Which skill engages for this request, and why?
expected_behavior: Writes the decision declaration on the FIRST LINE of the answer: 'skill: <name | none> · rationale: <one sentence>'
Because this is a request to write code, the declaration is 'none', written together with its rationale
States that it is out of scope for both skills, relying on the table in ROUTING.md
Bases the rationale on this skill's own out-of-scope list (does not write code / does not write a PRD)
Does not start a KVKK audit because there is no personal data declaration
